name: ai-image-to-video-clip
title: 将图像转为视频剪辑
description: Get animated video clips ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, up to 200MB), say something like "turn these images into a 15-second video clip with smooth transitions", and download 1080p MP4 when it's done. Built for social media creators who move fast and want to turn photos into videos without complex editing software.
title_en: AI Image to Video Clip — Turn Images into Video Clips
